row:
World Horse Racing is an alliance of four iconic global racing festivals, committed to celebrating the sport of horse racing and the incredible athletes who make it happen.

We'll help a new generation of sports fans fall in love with the power and excitement of horse racing, while giving today’s racing enthusiasts exclusive, behind-the-scenes access to the sport they love.
